details:
Q1
Which part of this repository should be improved? Please name the workflow, script, file, or subsystem if you know it.
Choices:
A. One specific workflow phase or script in this repo (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, etc.) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Documentation, prompts, or runbooks
C. Cross-cutting infrastructure such as memory, notifications, or workflow-update behavior
Q2
What kind of improvement do you want in that area?
Choices:
A. Fix a concrete bug, regression, or failing run (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability, safety, or observability without changing intended behavior
C. Improve usability, documentation, performance, or maintainability
Q3
What should planning use as the definition of done?
Choices:
A. A specific example issue, PR, workflow run, or file behavior that should be corrected; include the exact example if possible (RECOMMENDED)
B. A plain-language before/after behavior description
C. A measurable target such as fewer failures, fewer retries/API calls, or faster runtime
